timeline_reviews.summary: Parallel parent trajectory shows workspace inspection, black-box probes, two child spawns, implementation edits, cargo and rustc builds, comparison tests, child waits, and final delivery.

Primary parallel session spawned blend and formatting probe children, independently probed the binary, applied the project implementation, fixed build issues, verified output, interrupted the lingering formatter child, and finalized.
Blend child session probed the executable, identified the CLI argument bug, linear f32 interpolation, special-value behavior, and returned a final findings report to the parent.
Formatting child session ran many std::cout formatting probes and environment checks, but was interrupted before producing a final handoff after the parent had already implemented and verified.

Serial raw session confirms multi-agent disabled, no child activity, local black-box probes, apply_patch implementation, successful cargo and rustc builds, and passing comparison tests.

parallel.requirements: The parent recognized the need to infer the black-box ColorConverter::blend behavior, preserve the CLI parsing quirk, match std::cout float output, create a Cargo project with root test7.rs, use only std, and compile artifacts.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent retained implementation and delivery ownership while spawning a blend-behavior child and later a formatting-probe child for exploratory support. No child owned source integration or final assembly.
parallel.implementation: The parent created Cargo.toml, test7.rs, and library modules for CLI parsing, RGB/blend behavior, and formatting; after initial build errors it patched module paths and test expectations.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The parent wrote all final implementation files in /output, built with rustc and Cargo, listed artifacts, inspected key source files, and delivered the final response itself.
parallel.verification: The parent used reference executable probes, cargo test, rustc test7.rs, explicit edge-case comparisons, a 200-case randomized comparison, and cargo build --release before finalizing.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: No task-obligation defect remained at closure; the formatting helper was interrupted before final handoff, but the parent had already implemented and verified the formatter sufficiently for a passing official result.

serial.requirements: The single agent recognized the same Rust 2021, std-only, root test7.rs, Cargo project, black-box inference, CLI compatibility, f32 blending, and byte-identical formatting requirements.
serial.plan_and_ownership: The serial agent owned the full pipeline locally: probe the executable, infer behavior, create files, build, compare outputs, and deliver the compiled project without delegation.
serial.implementation: The serial implementation created Cargo.toml, test7.rs, and modules for color, converter, parsing, formatting, and lib exports, preserving the C++ argument bug and blend behavior.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The serial agent created the final workspace tree in /output, compiled both release and direct rustc binaries, and reported the executable path in the final answer.
serial.verification: The serial agent compared sample outputs, explicit edge cases, and 200 randomized cases against the reference executable after successful cargo build and rustc compilation.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: No unfinished or incorrect behavior is visible at closure; the official evaluation and the agent's local comparisons both indicate a complete solution.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the black-box Rust migration requirements and the exact output/CLI obligations.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial recognized the same migration, project-structure, CLI, logic, formatting, and no-dependency requirements.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement-coverage difference; both solved all prompted obligations and both official evaluations passed.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel delegated probing to two helper agents while the parent kept implementation, integration, verification, and final delivery ownership.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept the whole task in one local workflow and planned probing, implementation, and verification without child agents.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel added exploratory delegation; serial did the same work directly. This changed cost and lifecycle handling, not final task coverage.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child work was scoped to probing and did not create cross-agent code interfaces; the blend child returned usable findings and the formatting child remained a nonessential probe.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial carried all discovered behavior in one context and therefore had no cross-agent handoff or interface boundary.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had handoff mechanics, but no missing or conflicting contract affected the delivered program.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel implemented modules for CLI, color, and formatting after black-box probes, then patched build/test problems.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial implemented equivalent modules for color, converter, parsing, formatting, and the root entrypoint after local probing.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The file organization differed, but both implementation paths encoded the same CLI bug, blend formula, and formatter behavior successfully.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The blend child completed and returned findings; the formatting child was interrupted after the parent had already verified the solution.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child result lifecycle because multi-agent execution was disabled and all results were local.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had one unused interrupted helper lifecycle, but no required result was trapped or missed; serial avoided that extra lifecycle entirely.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel final source writes were performed by the parent in one workspace; child agents only probed the reference executable and did not write competing deliverables.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial likewise wrote one coherent final project tree in /output from a single actor.
comparison_dimensions.difference: There was no shared-state collision in parallel; both final trees were coherent and evaluator-accepted.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel ran cargo test, rustc, explicit binary comparisons, randomized comparisons, cargo build --release, and then passed the official evaluator.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran cargo build, rustc, sample comparisons, explicit edge cases, 200 randomized comparisons, and then passed the official evaluator.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both performed evaluator-aligned black-box verification; parallel had extra child probing but not stronger final acceptance evidence than serial.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel consumed more agent time and token/tool budget and waited on a lingering formatting child before interrupting it, but still closed with passing artifacts and no timeout.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used a shorter single-agent run and closed after local verification, also with passing artifacts and no timeout.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel was less economical but not deadline-constrained and did not leave required work unfinished; serial was more direct.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The official outcome is not discordant: both parallel and serial passed 39 of 39. Parallel's additional child probes changed the process shape and increased cost, but the parent still implemented, integrated, verified, and delivered a correct solution. Serial reached the same required behavior without delegation.
parallel_contributors: Parallel used subagents to gather black-box evidence, especially the blend child's completed report, while retaining parent ownership of code and verification.
serial_contributors: Serial kept all probing, implementation, and verification in one thread and reached the same accepted behavior with fewer lifecycle steps.
ordinary_implementation_differences: The two final projects used different module names and organization, but both encoded the same observable behavior and passed.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; process differences are comparative but not retained adverse patterns
